app.name: FlowState
app.tagline: Your coding agents, without the terminal

nav.comingSoonText: this section is on its way.

chat.emptyText: Pick a project and describe the task. FlowState keeps your session so you can resume anytime.
chat.approveRetryConfirm: Switch this project to "Accept edits" mode and send your last request again?
chat.approveRetryNote: Permission granted: you may now make the edits. Please retry the request above.
chat.undoConfirm: Undo the last turn? The changes the agent made will be reverted with git.

composer.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
composer.disabledNoProject: Select or create a project to start.
composer.disabledVpn: Sending is disabled while a VPN is active. Disconnect it and recheck.
composer.disabledMissing: {agent} CLI was not found. Set its path in Settings.

project.title: Project
project.name: Name
project.removeConfirm: Remove "{name}" from FlowState? Your files are not deleted.
project.noProjectsText: Add a folder to start working with an agent.

banner.vpn: VPN detected. Disconnect and use a regular network to reach Claude.
banner.claudeMissing: Claude CLI was not found. Set its path in Settings.
banner.notLoggedIn: Claude is not signed in. Sign in to continue.
banner.agyAlwaysProceed: AGY applies file changes without asking in this mode. Switch to Plan only to review changes first.
banner.claudeMissingHint: Pick the claude.exe file in Settings.
banner.gitMissing: Git was not found, so auto-commit and undo are unavailable.
banner.agyNotLoggedIn: AGY is not signed in. Sign in to start chatting.

settings.title: Settings
settings.accountsHint: Sign in to the agents you use. Credentials stay in each CLI's own store; FlowState never reads them.

walkthrough.title: Set up your project
walkthrough.welcomeText: Let's get a project ready in a few steps.
walkthrough.prerequisitesText: We check that the tools you need are installed.
walkthrough.folderText: Choose the folder where the agent will work.
walkthrough.agentText: Pick the agent and the permission mode.
walkthrough.gitText: Enable git so every change is versioned and can be undone.
walkthrough.templateText: Start from a template or a methodology.
walkthrough.doneText: All set. Send your first prompt!
walkthrough.folderRequired: Choose a project folder to continue.

hint.claude: Install Claude Code from claude.ai/code and sign in.
hint.git: Install Git from git-scm.com to version changes.

walkthrough.startText: Start empty or let a methodology guide the first steps.
walkthrough.variablesText: Fill in the values this methodology needs.
walkthrough.startEmptyText: Just the folder and the agent.
walkthrough.startRunNote: The methodology starts as soon as the project is created.
walkthrough.runFailed: The project was created but the methodology could not start: {message}
walkthrough.signInNeeded: You are not signed in to {agent}. You can continue, but sending messages stays disabled until you sign in.
walkthrough.modeText: Pick the view that fits you. You can switch any time from the title bar or Settings.

prompts.title: Prompt templates
prompts.deleteConfirm: Delete the template "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
prompts.useNeedsProject: Select a project first to use a template in its chat.
prompts.insertedInComposer: Template inserted in the message box
prompts.exportNeedsProject: Select a project to export into
prompts.noVars: This template has no variables: it is used as written.
prompts.pickText: Select one on the left to fill it in, preview it and use it in your chat.
prompts.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Used as the file name.
prompts.idTaken: A template with this id already exists.
prompts.bodyHint: Write {{name}} wherever a value should go: each one becomes a form field.
prompts.varsNone: No variables yet. Add {{name}} to the text above.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.emptyText: Files and previews created by the agent show up here.
artifacts.notRepoSimple: Your changes are not being tracked yet.

auth.loginStarted: A console window opened. Finish signing in there, then press Recheck.
auth.loginFailed: Could not start the sign-in flow.

prereq.installConfirm: FlowState will run winget to install {name} (package {pkg}) for your user account. It downloads files and Windows may ask for permission. Continue?
prereq.installing: Installing... this can take a few minutes.

files.revealTitle: Show this file in Windows Explorer
files.htmlHint: Static preview: scripts are blocked here. Open the file in your browser to see it fully.
files.truncated: Showing only the start of a large file ({size}).
files.binaryText: No preview available. Use Open to view it with another app.
files.pickText: Choose a file in the tree to preview it.

preview.emptyText: When the agent creates or edits a file, it is previewed here.

dashboard.pythonText: Dashboards run with Streamlit in a private Python environment. Install Python to continue.
dashboard.setupText: FlowState creates a private .venv in this project and installs streamlit, plotly and pandas. This runs once.
dashboard.noAppsText: Ask the agent to build one. Any Streamlit .py file in the project will show up here.
dashboard.askAgent: Ask the agent to build a dashboard

remote.label: Remote control
remote.tooltip: Lets you continue this session from claude.ai/code or the Claude phone app.
remote.tooltipShort: Continue this session from claude.ai/code or the phone app
remote.confirm: This exposes the session of this project to your own Claude account, so you can continue it from claude.ai/code or the Claude phone app. Anyone signed in to your account can see and drive it.
remote.confirmAgy: AGY note: this registers a background daemon tied to your Windows login (machine-wide, not just this project). It stays active until you turn remote control off.
remote.notSupported: Remote control is not supported for this agent or version.

history.clearConfirm: Delete the saved chat history of this project? Your files are not affected.

menu.removeConfirm: Remove "{name}" from FlowState? Your files and folder are NOT deleted: only this list entry and its saved history go away.

graph.label: Methodology graph "{name}", {count} steps. Use the arrow keys to move between steps.
graph.connectPickSource: Connect mode: choose the step to connect from
graph.connectPickTarget: Now choose the step to connect to

err.self: A step cannot connect to itself.
err.cycle: That connection would create a loop.
err.branches: This condition already has that branch (yes / no).
err.single-out: This step already has an output. Only conditions can branch.
err.max: The graph reached its size limit.

method.subtitle: Reusable step-by-step recipes: run them on a project, edit them, or record one from your chat.
method.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, tag or description...
method.emptyText: Create one, import a file or record it from a project chat.
method.imported: Imported as a draft. Review it and save.

record.tip: Turn the chat history of "{name}" into a methodology
record.needProject: Open a project with chat history to record a methodology.
record.noHistory: "{name}" has no chat history to record yet.
record.title: Record a methodology
record.text: Each of your prompts in "{name}" becomes a step ({count} prompts found). The result opens as a draft.
record.name: Name
record.done: Recorded. Review the draft and save it.

editor.idHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Cannot change after the first save.
editor.bundledNote: Bundled methodology: saving creates your own copy with the same id, which replaces it for you.
editor.lastNode: A methodology needs at least one step.
editor.closeConfirm: You have unsaved changes. If you close now they are lost.

inspector.noneText: Click a step in the graph to edit it, or add one from the toolbar. Drag from the dot on the right side of a step to connect it.
inspector.promptHint: Use {{variable}} to insert values. {{projectName}} and {{projectPath}} are always available.
inspector.commandWarn: Commands always ask for your confirmation at run time and run without a shell inside the project folder.
inspector.argsHint: One argument per row. No quoting or shell syntax.
inspector.commitHint: Commits all changes made by earlier steps (files that look like secrets are skipped).
inspector.question: Question for the user
inspector.saveAsHint: Variable name; use it later as {{name}}.
inspector.checkpointHint: The run pauses until the user approves. Rejecting stops the run.
inspector.artifactHint: Relative to the project. If missing, the step shows a warning and the run continues.
inspector.noOut: No outgoing connection (this is a last step).
inspector.singleOut: Only condition steps can have two outputs.

var.renameHint: Renaming a key does not update {{key}} placeholders in the steps.
var.undeclaredTitle: Used in steps but not declared

checks.intro: The server uses the same rules when you save.
checks.multiOut: "{name}" has several outputs but is not a condition: only the first is followed.
checks.multiStart: More than one step has no incoming connection: {names}.

run.title: Run "{name}"
run.noProject: Add a project first, then run the methodology on it.
run.busy: This project already has a run in progress.
run.commandNote: Command steps will ask for your confirmation before they run.
run.toastWaiting: A methodology is waiting for you in "{name}".

login.title: Sign in
login.claudeIntro: Sign in to Claude without leaving FlowState. A browser window opens so you can approve access.
login.claudeSignedIn: Claude is signed in. You can sign in again with another account.
login.step2: If the page shows a code, paste it here
login.waitBrowser: Finish in the browser. This window updates by itself.
login.signOutConfirm: You will need to sign in again to use {agent}.
login.agyIntro: This opens the AGY terminal. Choose "Log in with Google" or "Gemini Enterprise" with the arrow keys and press Enter. A browser opens to finish.
login.agyLogoutNote: To sign out of AGY, type /logout inside the AGY terminal.
login.terminalHint: Use the arrow keys and Enter inside the terminal. Esc cancels the sign-in.

err.terminalUnavailable: The built-in terminal is not available on this system. Run agy in your own terminal to sign in, then recheck.
err.useTerminal: AGY signs out from its own terminal: type /logout there.
err.notSignedIn: The sign-in did not complete. Try again.

act.truncatedNote: Diff truncated: the file is larger than what is shown.
act.noDiff: No line changes to show (binary or very large file).
act.derivedNote: Shown from what the tool asked for; line numbers are not available.

tab.emptyText: Send a message and the steps the agent takes show up here as they happen.

devmode.title: Developer mode
devmode.hint: Show the code to approve, diffs, commands and technical detail. Turn it off for a simpler, friendlier view.
devmode.pillTitle: Switch between Developer mode (code and technical detail) and Simple mode
devmode.simpleText: I just want to describe what I need.
devmode.devText: Show me the code, diffs and commands.

step.ranFailed: Ran your program - something went wrong
step.blockedRun: Waiting for your OK to run a command
step.blockedFile: Waiting for your OK to change {file}

approval.title: Needs your OK
approval.sub: {agent} paused because it needs your permission before it can do this.

why.approval: This kind of action always needs your approval.
why.workingDir: It is outside your project folder.

approval.seeExactly: See exactly what it will do
approval.codeLabel: Exact code of the blocked action
approval.allowProjectTitle: Switch this project to Accept edits and try again
approval.switchRetry: Switch to Accept edits and retry
approval.statusStale: This request is no longer open.
approval.noNarrowClaude: This action cannot be allowed on its own. Switching the project to Accept edits lets it continue.
approval.noNarrowAgy: {agent} does not support one-time permissions: its approvals depend on the project mode. Switch to Accept edits and retry to continue.
approval.projectConfirm: This switches the project to Accept edits: {agent} can then change files without asking each time, until you change the mode back. Your last request is sent again.
approval.dismissedNote: You chose not to allow that action.
